scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Corporation.
The Kafra services
are always on your side.
How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临卡普拉公司！
卡普拉服务永远在您身边。
您需要什么服务呢？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666W-weeeelc-c-come
to th-the K-kaaafrrrra
C-coorpoor-r-ratioooonn...^000000

[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Coporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临，^ff0000{0}^000000的成员。
无论您去往何处，卡普拉公司都与您同在。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So, have you come from a faraway land to study our culture, or are you just sightseeing?
In either case, why not stay awhile?
The air is eternally heavy with the
scent of pleasant wildflowers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您是远道而来了解我们的文化，还是来观光的呢？
无论如何，不妨多待一会儿。
这里的空气总是弥漫着怡人的野花香。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our many Kafra
service locations, you're never
far from home.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉服务网点遍布各地，让您无论走到哪里，都有宾至如归的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Because of the ^FF0000Limited
Transport Agreement^000000, the
Kafra Corporation cannot
provide Teleport Services
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
受^FF0000有限运输协议^000000限制，卡普拉公司无法在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国提供传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We ask that you please
use the Airship Service
instead. Thank you for your
understanding and cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
请您改用飞空艇服务。
感谢您的理解与配合。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry but another guild member is using the guild storage
right now.  Please wait until that person is finished.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，另一位公会成员正在使用公会仓库。
请等待该成员使用完毕。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666S-s-ssoooorry,
y-you're a-a-aaaa
Nooviiice... N-neeeds
B-basic sssskill l-level 6...^000000

[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，初心者的基本技能需要达到6级，才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Zeeeeeny...
M-more z-zeny...!
N-neeed 150... zeny...
Ergh! T-taking bl-blood~!^000000

[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法使用仓库服务。
使用仓库需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Thank you.. for... using...^000000
[Kafra Employee]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉 职员]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
这就为您打开仓库。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
请选择您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法使用瞬间移动服务。
前往{0}的费用是{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人系职业开放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists and Biochemists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人、铁匠、神工匠、炼金术士和生物化学家开放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您已经装备了一辆手推车。
很遗憾，我们一次只能租给每位顾客一辆。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can only rent a cart after learning the "Push Cart" skill.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
必须先学会“手推车使用”技能，才能租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is {0} zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
手推车租赁费是{0} Zeny。
您想要租用手推车吗？

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付{0} Zeny的手推车租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let's see...
{0}...
Ah, you have a total of
{1} Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
让我看看...
{0}...
啊，您共有{1}点特殊储备点数。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您可以前往艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部，用特殊储备点数兑换奖励。
多使用我们便捷的服务，就能享受奖励计划带来的优惠。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
您的复活点已保存于{0}。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
卡普拉公司始终致力于提供最优质的服务，希望能满足您的冒险需求，不负您的期待。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Kaffffra n-never
diiiiiiiiiiiiiies. On...
On y-yooour siiiiide~^000000

[Kafra Employee]
Saved.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
已保存。
感谢您的惠顾。
